q: Which is the most dangerous Firestore mistake?
A budget alert on Blaze will …
o: notify you when spending crosses a threshold
why: A hard stop has to be built by you.

q: A service-account key can safely be committed to a private repo.
why: Keep it out of git; it grants admin power and bypasses rules.

q: Before adopting Firestore, a good exit-strategy question is …
o: If I had to leave in six months, what would I rewrite?
How many collections can I make?
why: If the answer is 'everything', that is the lock-in price.
